text: So sorry to trouble you this late. I'm looking after my granddaughter, she's 2, and she's got a temperature of 38.7. I think her throat is sore, she keeps pointing at it and fussing, but she is drinking her juice and water ok. She's also got a few insect bites on her arms that she keeps scratching. I pressed a glass on the bites like you're meant to and they went pale, so I don't think it's anything there, but I'm not sure I did it right. I probably worry too much, I just wanted to check whether she needs to be seen or if I'm ok to keep her home till her mum's back
